hero.badge: The operating system for field operations
hero.subtitle: From work order to site closeout — the full history of every visit, in real time.

features.heading: What's inside
features.subheading: Modules that are actually used in the field, not collecting dust in a demo

orders.title: Orders & SLA
orders.description: Full order lifecycle from creation to the completion act — with an SLA timer and automatic escalation of overdue orders.

dispatch.title: Dispatch center
dispatch.description: Real-time map, drag-and-drop assignment, nearest available technician.

atm.title: ATM servicing
atm.description: Cassette fill levels, cash collection, emergency calls — a dedicated workflow for ATMs and card recyclers.

cleaning.title: Team cleaning cycles
cleaning.description: Sites are assigned to teams; each cycle auto-creates orders for every site and closes itself once everything is done.

photo.title: Photo reports & signature
photo.description: Geotagged photos, client e-signature, checklists per job type — right from the phone.

analytics.title: Analytics & ranking
analytics.description: KPIs by team and contractor, employee ranking, SLA comparison — on one screen.

multitenancy.title: Multi-tenancy
multitenancy.description: The bank and every contractor see only their own data; access is scoped by role down to a single order.

mobile.title: Mobile app
mobile.description: Offline photo upload queue, geofence auto-arrival, QR confirmation — works even on poor connectivity.

banks.title: Banks & networks
banks.point1: One unified view across all contractors and teams
banks.point2: SLA breaches are visible instantly, no phone calls needed
banks.point3: Public tracking link for clients — no login required

contractors.title: Contractors
contractors.point1: Your own cabinet — see only your orders and sites
contractors.point2: Cleaning cycles and territories close themselves
contractors.point3: Photo reports and checklists never get lost in chats

trust.heading: Your data is protected at every layer
trust.subheading: A bank can't hand its data to a system it doesn't trust — so Corpi's architecture was designed for protection from day one, not bolted on afterward.

isolation.title: Data isolation
isolation.description: Every company runs in its own protected boundary — access to another tenant's data is ruled out at the architecture level, not just by a setting.

encryption.title: Encrypted connections
encryption.description: All traffic runs over TLS; passwords are stored as one-way hashes and are never visible, even to us.

access.title: Role-based access
access.description: Permissions are scoped by role down to a single order — an employee sees exactly what they need to do their job, nothing more.

audit.title: Full activity history
audit.description: Every status change, comment, and attachment is recorded in an event log — nothing is lost or quietly rewritten after the fact.

backups.title: Regular backups
backups.description: Scheduled data backups protect against loss from any technical failure.

monitoring.title: 24/7 monitoring
monitoring.description: Infrastructure is under continuous observation — outages and anomalies are caught instantly, not reported by frustrated clients.

cta.heading: Ready to try it?
cta.subheading: Create a company in a minute — your own isolated organization, no card, no waiting.
